name: cti-e2e-cypress
description: E2E automation project for Inventario CTI using Cypress and TypeScript.

scripts.cy:run:regressivo: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE cypress run --env grepTags=@regressivo
scripts.cy:run:complementar: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE cypress run --env grepTags=@complementar
scripts.cy:run:chrome: env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE -u ELECTRON_NO_ATTACH_CONSOLE cypress run --browser chrome
